description: Find deadline rules by plain words (for example "opposition to motion", "answer complaint", "notice of appeal"). Searches rule names, ids, citations and triggers. Optionally limit to one rule_set (TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL). Returns up to 20 rules with their rule_set, rule_id and rule page URL; use get_rule or calculate_deadline next.

query.description: Words describing the deadline, e.g. "opposition to motion" or "CCP 1005"

rule_set.description: Optional rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

name: search_rules
